# Kestrel Liner Agencies Ltd

Kestrel Liner Agencies Ltd is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Kestrel Liner Agencies is a fully licensed global logistics company that provides FCL/LCL ocean freight management services, breakbulk, and more. Kestrel Liner Agencies Ltd employs 128 people (+4.1% YoY, +5 people) and has an annual revenue of $20.9M, founded in 1994. Headquartered in United Kingdom, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across 9 countries (including United Kingdom, United States, Dominican Republic, Trinidad and Tobago, and Barbados).

## About

The UK’s largest Liner Agency company, the market leaders representing niche carriers to global destinations.

Whether you are a large multi-national , SME or a private individual, we will offer you the same high level of customer service and support. We recognise that the strength of our success your success.
HQ in London Stansted and UK offices in Hull, Manchester, Felixstowe, Dover , and global offices in Miami and LA USA, Cape Town South Africa, Namibia, Hong Kong, St Vincent & The Grenadines, Guyana, Barbados, Trinidad and Jamaica, with agency representation in all other major global cities. 
We offer our principals and customers the very best there is to offer in terms of global reach with local focus – our mission statement says it all.

Our services include breakbulk, heavy lift, out of gauge, RoRo, FCL and LCL, airfreight and temperature controlled cargo. Complementary services include freight forwarding to regions where we do not represent our own Shipping Lines, Purchasing and Project Management, as well as tailored hand carriage services. 
Every member of our team is an industry expert with solutions for your shipping needs.

- [2026-09-16 · Posted · 9 reactions] [How can shipping be more environmentally friendly ? The burden is...](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/kestrel-liner-agencies-ltd_tropicalshipping-tropiccarib-sustainableshipping-activity-7505904816985010176-odW_)
  > How can shipping be more environmentally friendly ?  The burden is on us to be sure that we act responsibly.
  >
  > How do we do that ?
  >
  > We only work with the most reputable shipping companies in the world.
  >
  > Shipping and Logistics in general, inevitably by their very nature, use resources for energy and have emissions - just like your car.
  >
  > Our job as a Liner Agent is to represent the Shipping Lines and in doing so we by default are working in tandem with their own programmes to ensure we do some in the best ways possible.
  >
  > The global cargo that we bring to the Caribbean via Florida ships out to all of the islands with Tropical Shipping.  We have been their global agent since Kestrel’s inception more than 30 years ago, and they are as environmentally conscious now as they were then.

  >

  >
  > Global Shipping with Kestrel - not just easier and faster, but more environmentally friendly.
  >
  > #TropicalShipping #TropicCarib #SustainableShipping #Caribbean #GlobalShipping

# KestrelMare

KestrelMare is a Maritime Transportation company. KestrelMare is a single player for the project cargo market, offering a greater fleet and a range of services. They have the official launch of KestrelMare and have gained a stronger player in the cargo market. KestrelMare employs 5 people (+150.0% YoY, +3 people), founded in 2024. Headquartered in Georgia.

KestrelMare provides shipowners with a comprehensive and integrated service package for the heavy lift and project cargo sector.
